pull.body:
This patch adds new exceptions and protocol errors required by the
Cluster Mirroring feature. No exception is marked as public for now. We
can change that later if needed.

Reviewers: Ken Huang <s7133700@gmail.com>, Luke Chen <showuon@gmail.com>

repo.name: kafka
repo.description: Apache Kafka - A distributed event streaming platform

reviews.body: **Thanks for this patch. Could you add Javadoc for these new exceptions?**
Thanks for the update, @fvaleri. Could you take a look at the build error?

> The problem is that most/all these exceptions are planned to be internal. What about removing Javadoc and adding back when/if any of them surfaces to the user?

I think we could exclude these exceptions from the `:clients` Javadoc configuration in `build.gradle` so they remain out of the public docs until Cluster Mirroring is complete.
LGTM. Let's wait for any further comments from @showuon.

review_comments.body: Could you add a comment for this change? To make sure we don't forget to remove these once the Cluster Mirroring feature is complete.
@m1a2st my bad, that was just an attempt I forgot to remove. Fixed now.

issue_comments.body: Hi @m1a2st, thanks for the review. Javadoc added.

> Thanks for the update, @fvaleri. Could you take a look at the build error?

The error is caused by the addition of javadoc:

```sh
[MISSING_PUBLICAPI_ANNOTATION] org.apache.kafka.common.errors.ReadOnlyTopicException: Class appears in javadoc but lacks @InterfaceAudience.Public annotation
[MISSING_PUBLICAPI_ANNOTATION] org.apache.kafka.common.errors.ClusterMirrorAuthorizationException: Class appears in javadoc but lacks @InterfaceAudience.Public annotation
[MISSING_PUBLICAPI_ANNOTATION] org.apache.kafka.common.errors.UnknownClusterMirrorException: Class appears in javadoc but lacks @InterfaceAudience.Public annotation
[MISSING_PUBLICAPI_ANNOTATION] org.apache.kafka.common.errors.TopicAlreadyInClusterMirrorException: Class appears in javadoc but lacks @InterfaceAudience.Public annotation
[MISSING_PUBLICAPI_ANNOTATION] org.apache.kafka.common.errors.MirrorConfigNotAvailableException: Class appears in javadoc but lacks @InterfaceAudience.Public annotation
[MISSING_PUBLICAPI_ANNOTATION] org.apache.kafka.common.errors.ClusterMirrorAlreadyExistsException: Class appears in javadoc but lacks @InterfaceAudience.Public annotation
[MISSING_PUBLICAPI_ANNOTATION] org.apache.kafka.common.errors.SourceMetadataNotAvailableException: Class appears in javadoc but lacks @InterfaceAudience.Public annotation
[MISSING_PUBLICAPI_ANNOTATION] org.apache.kafka.common.errors.TopicNotInClusterMirrorException: Class appears in javadoc but lacks @InterfaceAudience.Public annotation
[MISSING_PUBLICAPI_ANNOTATION] org.apache.kafka.common.errors.InvalidMirrorStateException: Class appears in javadoc but lacks @InterfaceAudience.Public annotation
```

The problem is that most/all these exceptions are planned to be internal. What about removing Javadoc and adding back when/if any of them surfaces to the user?
@m1a2st are you happy with the current status of this PR? Thanks.

commit.message:
KAFKA-21225: Add mirror exceptions

This patch adds new exceptions and protocol errors required by the
Cluster Mirroring feature. No exception is marked as public for now.
We can change that later if needed.

Signed-off-by: Federico Valeri <fedevaleri@gmail.com>

Add missing audience annotation

Signed-off-by: Federico Valeri <fedevaleri@gmail.com>

Exclude ex from clients Javadoc

Signed-off-by: Federico Valeri <fedevaleri@gmail.com>

Remove unnecessary exclusions

Signed-off-by: Federico Valeri <fedevaleri@gmail.com>

+/**
+ * The cluster mirror with the given name already exists.
+ * This error occurs when attempting to create a cluster mirror that has already been created.
+ */
+public class ClusterMirrorAlreadyExistsException extends ApiException {
+    private static final long serialVersionUID = 1L;
+
+    public ClusterMirrorAlreadyExistsException(String message) {
+        super(message);
+    }
